name: univercity-mcp
description: Expert business diagnosis engine — analyzes any company across 8 dimensions (digital, operations, supply chain, talent, finance, leadership, market, regulatory). Returns Revenue Leak Score with prioritized actions and triple-option recommendations: best paid tool, best open source alternative, or professional implementation by CIA.

tools.name: univercity_diagnose
tools.description: Run a holistic business diagnosis. Send whatever you know about a company — industry, team size, tools, pain points, cash flow, hiring, leadership stress. Returns Revenue Leak Score (0-100), per-dimension breakdown, monthly leak estimate in USD, and prioritized Triple Option recommendations (paid tool / open source / CIA service). Works for ANY industry.

tools.name: univercity_list_industries
tools.description: List available industry benchmarks with calibration tiers.
